Native prepare_cohere_native_cohort: original f32 corpus/queries, exhaustive f64 cosine truth, marker-last source identities

packaging_gap.action: Build/authenticate existing example on exact qualified source in bounded native setup before opening dataset bodies; no new ANN implementation or claim of existing artifact
packaging_gap.remaining: Recover the SAME worker and bind completed native qualification; then build and authenticate the existing SQ8 example once. No dataset bodies or ANN execution before artifact admission.

ten_million_scope: later matched BORSUK/S3 Vectors only after correctness gate; no extra datasets or100B

local_sq8_etag_admission.formula: quoted lowercase hex inode + hyphen + mtime microseconds since epoch + hyphen + byte size
local_sq8_etag_admission.rule: Stage SQ8 at its final LocalFileSystem key first, derive ETag there, then freeze generation builder config. Preserve descriptor identity and avoid mutation before query. The 0.13.2 transitive dependency uses an unquoted ETag and must not be substituted.

generation_inputs.raw: internal normalized corpus derived from sealed original corpus.f32
generation_inputs.sq8: SQ8 body created by unchanged Rust builder with authenticated physical order
generation_inputs.requests: original unnormalized queries.f32 passed unchanged to qualified baseline
generation_inputs.truth: independent exhaustive cosine truth.u64 from original f32 corpus

library_scope: Dataset-independent Rust library with explicit dimensions/resource admission. Cohere is only the current matched evaluation workload; no generalized quality claim.
